Abstract 
 Ayurvedic and Unani medicine place a high importance on the bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), a large deciduous herbal tree. It is referred to as Baheda in Hindi, and Vibheeta in Sanskrit, which signifies one who eliminates the fear of illness. It belongs to the combretaceae family. Various plant substances, including tannins, beta-sitosterol, ethyl, ellagic, and gallic acid, are present in bibhitaki fruit. The laxative and astringent qualities of the seed kernel’s yellow oil make it valuable. Even bibhitaki’s roots and leaves are potentially therapeutic. According to the Ayurvedic texts, this traditional plant means ‘fearless of disease’ because it is a wildcrafted fruit, it is not grown but rather is taken from wild forests. According to traditions, bibhitaki may manage illnesses, extend life, and improve one’s strength and stamina. Ayurvedic medicine also makes use of bibhitaki because of its anti-aging benefits. It can help lessen ageing symptoms like fine lines and wrinkles and is believed to have a revitalizing impact on the body. Additionally, it assists in nourishing the skin and enhances both its general health and look. So today we will read about the herb Vibhitaka (Terminalia bellirica) in detail. 



 Introduction 
 Triphala, which has been used for centuries, has vibhitaka as one of its components. It serves as an anti-hypertensive, hepatoprotective, anticancer, anti-diarrheal, anti-antimicrobial, antioxidant and anti-diabetic agent. Bibhitaki is a member of Jwarahara, one of the three major categories of herbs that are used to treat fever. Herbs utilized during Panchakarma detoxification include Virechanopaga and Kasahara, which are used to treat colds and coughs. It is generally known that the ayurvedic formula calms the Vata and Kapha doshas. According to several studies, the fruit’s bioactive components have antidepressant properties that make them effective at reducing anxiety and stress. One of the three Triphala fruits, Bibhitaki, aids in maintaining Kapha. The dried and powdered bibhitaki fruit is utilized in Ayurvedic treatment. Additionally, it includes a number of other phytonutrients that have been demonstrated to improve the immune system and aid the body in protecting from infections.

sections.therapeutic_uses:
1. Kasa And Swasa (Cough And Asthma) 
 Vibhitaka is very effective in all types of cough and asthma. Vibhitaka powder of 10 gm mixed with honey and taken after food pacifies cough and dyspnea. 
 2. Atisara (Diarrhoea) 
 Burnt vibhitaka fruit combined with salt resolves the problem of diarrhoea. 
 3. Shotha (Odema) 
 The paste made from the vibhitaki fruit pulp calms burning and discomfort in all sorts of edemas. 
Additionally, rice water should be consumed with the vibhitaki paste. 
 4. Shwitra (Vitiligo) 
 Vibhitaka oil and black snake ash are applied locally. It eliminates all forms of vitiligo. 
 5. Netra Vikara (Eye Diseases) 
 Corneal opacity is eliminated by using a collyrium made of vibhitaka seed kernel combined with honey. 
 Sesame oil, asana decoction, bhringraj juice and vibhitaka oil are all combined and boiled in an iron pot. Use it as a nasal therapy, it improves vision. 
 6. Granthi And Visarpa (Cyst And Erysipelas) 
 Vibhitaka bark should be administered locally as a hot paste. 
 7. Ashmari (Calculus) 
 Vibhitaka seeds are mashed and consumed with wine. It eliminates calculus and fixes urine flaws. 
 8. Hridya Vikara (Heart Disease) 
 Vibhitaka and ashwagandha are combined, crushed, and combined with jaggery before being consumed with hot water. It reduces the vata that is present in the heart. 


 Therapeutic Indications 
 1. Acne (Mukha Dushika) 
 Vibhitaki is revitalizing and has astringent effects according to old ayurvedic scriptures. Recent studies have shown that vibhitaka possesses antibacterial activity. These characteristics make it useful in the treatment of acne as well as acne scars. 
 2. Constipation 
 Vibhitaki relieves constipation because of its rechana characteristics, which are laxatives. Additionally, vibhitaka’s lubricating action has a calming effect and facilitates stool evacuation. 
 3. Obesity (Medo Roga) 
 Due to its hot intensity, vibhitaki aids in boosting digestive fire, reducing toxins, and enhancing metabolism. Vibhitaka also aids in the treatment of obesity by removing accumulated bodily waste due to its laxative characteristics. 
 4. Hair loss (Khalitya) 
 Due to the astringent and drying effects of vibhitaki, which also helps to eliminate excess oil from the head and vibhitaki is a hair growth booster that can help with both hair loss and hair growth. 
 Wound (Vrana) 
 In addition to its antibacterial characteristics, vibhitaka possesses healing capabilities (Ropana properties), which aid in the wound’s speedy recovery as well as the prevention of subsequent infection. 


 Benefits Of Jyotishmati 

 Immunity booster – This unique fruit is utilized in various traditional treatments to strengthen the body against illnesses, strengthen the immune system, and combat microorganisms since it is high in antioxidants and biologically active substances. Additionally, it demonstrates that it has potent antibacterial, antifungal and antiviral properties that are crucial for avoiding infections and enhancing general health and fitness. 
 Keeps liver healthy – The fruit known as vibhitaki nourishes the liver. According to several studies, the extract promotes healthy lipid peroxidation, liver detoxification and liver fibrosis. 
 Relieves stress – Mood disorders such as anxiety and depression are harmful to your health, and the fruit vibhitaki is a miraculous remedy for stress . According to studies, the fruit’s ethanolic extracts have a potent impact on depression and can lessen stress. 
 Heal ulcers – The wonderful fruit vibhitaki can treat stomach ulcers. There is evidence that the antiulcer characteristics of the vibhitaki fruit, which are derived from plant substances like ellagic acid and gallic acid, aid digestion and soothe the stomach. 
 Prevent metabolic disorders – The risk of diabetes and cardiovascular disease can be raised by a combination of diseases known as metabolic syndrome. These illnesses are characterized by high blood pressure, obesity and blood sugar. According to research, bibhitaki has incredible therapeutic qualities and may help in avoiding metabolic syndrome. The powder, when dissolved in hot water, stimulates insulin sensitivity, lowers cholesterol, and aids in weight loss. 



 Vibhitaka’s Effects On The Various Bodily Systems 

 Nervous system – The pulp is both analgesic and intoxicant. This could be because of how vibhitaka treated majja (Bone marrow) dhatu. Insomnia and vata problems are treated with the pulp. 
 Digestive system – It is a laxative, anthelmintic and carminative due to its hot potency. Ripen fruit is astringent, whereas half-ripe fruit has a purgative effect. It controls excessive thirst and has antiemetic properties. It is effective for treating indigestion, helminthiasis, haemorrhoids, emesis and excessive thirst. Fruit that is just partially ripe helps with constipation, while dried fruit helps with dysentery and diarrhoea. 
 Respiratory system – By lowering bronchial inflammation, it aids in the treatment of cough and asthma . By holding the fruit’s rind in your mouth, you can cure symptoms of a cough, cold, hoarseness and asthma. 
 Circulatory system – Due to its astringent qualities, it is utilized as a blood coagulant. It is helpful for internal bleeding as well as more beneficial for hemoptysis. 
 Reproductive system – The pulp has aphrodisiac properties. One seed’s pulp should be consumed daily to boost libido and cure impotence. 
 Ophthalmic system – For the eyes, dried vibhitaka is beneficial. Vibhitaka is used locally to treat eye disorders when combined with honey.

It greatly affects each of the body’s seven dhatus and supports a long and healthy life. Baheda has been described in ayurvedic texts ranging back thousands of years as a proven treatment for a wide range of health issues. It is frequently utilized to alleviate cold and cough, treating sore throat, dealing with digestive anomalies, improving cardiac working, preventing infections of the skin, stimulating digestion, reducing urinary problems, enhancing immunity, and many other conditions due to its vital bio-active components and amazing medicinal qualities.
